description.value: Roundhouse Lodge is Whistler Blackcomb's main mid-mountain dining hub, situated at approximately 1,850 m elevation at the top of the Whistler Village Gondola. In summer it serves as the gateway to the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, making it a natural rest stop for uplift-assisted mountain bikers. The two-storey building is a landmark on Whistler Mountain and offers views of the surrounding Coast Mountains.
